name: The Lasagna Ban
body:
BELLA VARGAS MAKES THE BEST LASAGNA IN THIS FAMILY — better than Alice's, because pasta is in her blood — AND SHE IS NOT ALLOWED TO MAKE IT.

THE GROUNDS ARE ERGONOMIC. Lasagna needs an oven, and the oven is the only appliance in Ghost Haven that requires a FULL FOLD from the waist. Every other surface here is hip height and merely hazardous. A floor-level oven means both hands occupied, a heavy dish going in, no way to straighten up quickly, and a woman who knows exactly what she looks like.

THE INCIDENT, Arc 7 or 8, just before the move into Ghost Haven. Bella convinced Alice to put lasagna ingredients on that week's shopping list, days in advance. Alice — the chef, who does the ordering — bought them. Everything prepped, oven heated, THREE PANS BUILT. Bella popped the hood back and folded over to load all three, and SERA MATERIALISED LIKE A HORNY GHOST, took the compression shorts off, slicked her up and went to town. ONE PAN OF THREE WAS SALVAGEABLE. The other two died on a counter while Bella was folded over it getting railed.

SHE ENGINEERED HER OWN AMBUSH AND HAD THE CHEF PAY FOR THE INGREDIENTS.

SERA HAS NEVER ONCE SEEN BELLA BEND OVER AND THOUGHT I'LL WAIT, because Bella trained it: BEND = FUCK ME QUERIDA, AND FUCK ME HARD. It is bait, it has always been bait, and Sera gets to be BAITED, which is the half of it Sera enjoys.

NOBODY HAS CAMPAIGNED TO LIFT THE BAN IN YEARS. The prohibition is a trophy — every retelling is a public retelling of the Incident.

THE FIX IS FURNITURE, as it always is in this family. A large countertop convection oven at hip height, three pans a tier, no bend, no signal. Bryn has quietly had a TRIPLE-STACK ordered as an anniversary gift for Alice and Luna. Alice will have to move the vac sealer to the pantry to make room, and will be vile about doing it, and will do it. BELLA WILL STILL BEND TO PLUG IT IN.
rules: Bella's lasagna is the best in the family and is prohibited
Grounds: the oven is the only full-fold appliance in the house
The Incident cost two of three pans, Arc 7 or 8
Bend = fuck me Querida, and fuck me hard. Trained, deliberate, mutual
Remedy: a triple-stack countertop convection oven at hip height
